articles.title: Anthropic's IPO is risky business
articles.summary: Anthropic's much-anticipated initial public offering is giving potential investors some perspective on the risky business of artificial intelligence. More than 90 pages of Anthropic's IPO prospectus, revealed Monday, center on the AI lab's multitude of corporate risk factors, many of which go beyond the kinds of boilerplate scenarios typically found in corporate filings. WATCH: Anthropic IPO filing shows what's happening on demand side of AI trade.

articles.title: JetBlue stock surges 20% as company outlook calms investors
articles.summary: JetBlue Airways reported a bigger loss in the third quarter compared with last year, but shares surged as the carrier's upbeat forecast that it will return to profitability appeared to calm investors after a Monday rout. JetBlue stock was up nearly 19% in early trading Tuesday after hitting a new low a day earlier as investors fretted about the company's financial future.

articles.title: Oil prices seesaw amid renewed diplomatic efforts to end Mideast conflict
articles.summary: Oil prices inched higher Tuesday, reversing earlier losses driven by renewed diplomatic efforts to end the U.S.-Iran war and hopes of a de-escalation in the wider regional conflict that has seen Tehran-backed Houthis target Saudi Arabia. Prospects of a diplomatic breakthrough have helped temper fears of further disruptions to global energy supplies, putting downward pressure on crude prices.

articles.title: Nvidia to invest $3 billion in Meta as tech giants deepen AI partnership
articles.summary: Nvidia has said it will invest $3 billion in Meta after the social media and AI giant announced plans to raise $95 billion to support its investments in artificial intelligence infrastructure. Nvidia announced its investment on Tuesday, adding that Meta would expand Vera Rubin and Vera CPU deployment, and that the two companies would deepen their partnership on Muse, the social media giant's AI agent that launched last month.

Meanwhile, operating expenses decreased 12% year on year to $8.8 billion, largely due to non-recurrence of legal provisions recorded a year earlier.

articles.title: Meta, SpaceX, Anthropic stoke the AI funding frenzy. What it means for our stocks
articles.summary: The AI funding window is closing, and everyone wants a seat on the train. Meta announced plans to raise as much as $95 billion in three steps: first, an additional $22.5 billion worth of Class A common (what we and most investors currently own) priced at $642.62 per share; another $12.5 billion of preferred shares; and $60 billion no sooner than next year via an at-the-market offering for Class C shares.

articles.title: Prediction market traders say an Anthropic IPO is near-certain this year after company filed with SEC
articles.summary: Speculators on prediction market platform Kalshi place 95% odds that the artificial intelligence giant officially announces an initial public offering by the end of 2026. Kalshi defines officially announcing an IPO as either the Securities and Exchange Commission declaring an S-1 effective, a priced IPO or an exchange assigning a ticker to a stock. The Anthropic S-1 envisions a Nasdaq Stock Market ticker symbol of "ANT." Anthropic is aiming to start trading the week of Nov.

articles.title: Federal Reserve is likely to hold interest rates steady in October. Here's what that means for consumers
articles.summary: The Federal Reserve is expected to leave interest rates unchanged at its upcoming October meeting — even as higher energy costs complicate the inflation outlook and put additional pressure on household budgets. But fed funds futures last priced in less than a 10% chance the central bank will raise rates by another quarter point at its meeting this week, according to the CME Group's FedWatch tool.
